scenes.say: Do blue cut lenses really work? Let's split myth from fact.

scenes.en: Fact: There's no proof of that. The sun gives far more blue light.
scenes.ta: உண்மை: திரையின் நீல ஒளி கண்ணைச் சேதப்படுத்தும் என்பதற்கு ஆதாரம் இல்லை
scenes.say: Myth. Blue light from screens damages your eyes. Fact. There's no proof of that. The sun gives off far more blue light than any phone.

scenes.en: Fact: Breaks and the right power help most.
scenes.ta: உண்மை: இடைவேளையும் சரியான பவரும் தான் முக்கியம்
scenes.say: Myth. Blue cut lenses stop eye strain. Fact. Strain comes from staring and blinking less. Regular breaks and the right power help the most.

scenes.en: Many screen users find them more comfortable, with less glare.
scenes.say: So why choose them? Many screen users simply find them more comfortable, with less glare and reflection.

scenes.en: Screens late at night can disturb sleep. Put the phone away an hour before bed.
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show screen use late at night can disturb your sleep. Try putting the phone away an hour before bed.
